DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。展示で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with the exhibition?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この模型の高い所は、雪が厚い所でしょうか。横に冬の写真があるのでそう思いましたが、何を表す高さか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冬写真横の模型高さが積雪厚か表す量を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: Do the high parts of this model show where snow is deep? I thought so because there is a winter photograph beside it, but I'd like to know what the height represents.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the height of a model beside a winter photo represents snow depth, and what quantity it shows.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この模型は土地の起伏を表しています。雪の厚さを積み上げた物ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: This model represents the land's relief. It is not built up to show snow depth.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。白く見える部分も、模型の材料の色だけでは雪だと判断できないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 材料の白色だけで雪と判断できないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. We can't assume the white-looking parts are snow just from the model material's color either.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that the material's white color alone cannot identify snow.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 模型の説明と写真の説明を、それぞれ読んでみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please read the model explanation and photograph explanation separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 模型には地形、写真には冬の景色とあります。同じ場所を見せていても、模型の高さと写真の季節は別なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地形模型と冬写真の説明を別に読み高さと季節を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: The model says terrain, and the photo says winter scenery. Even though they show the same place, the model height and photo season are separate things.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the terrain model and winter photo descriptions separately and distinguish height from season in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうです。模型だけから、撮影した日の積雪量を読むことはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. You can't read the snow depth on the photograph's date from the model alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族には山や谷の形の模型と説明します。高い所ほどその日に雪が多かった、という説明はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族へ山谷形と伝え当日積雪大小を模型から推測しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell my family it models the shapes of mountains and valleys. I won't explain that higher parts had more snow that day.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will describe mountain and valley shapes to family without inferring that day's snow amounts from the model.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 大きさの縮め方などは、模型の解説をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please see the model explanation for details such as how the size is scaled down.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 縮尺も解説で確認します。高さを土地の起伏として読み、冬写真から考えた雪の厚さとは分けて記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 縮尺を解説で確認し起伏と想像した積雪を分け記録すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the scale in the explanation too. I'll read the height as terrain relief and record it separately from the snow depth I imagined from the winter photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the scale and separately record terrain relief and the imagined snow depth.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。説明で分からない点があればまたお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please ask again if anything in the explanation is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。バスについて何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with the bus?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約の出発時刻を過ぎたと思ったのですが、待合室の時計と携帯の時間が違います。便を取り直す前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 時計と携帯の時差があり再予約前に便の時刻確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought my booked departure time had passed, but the waiting-room clock and my phone show different times. I'd like to check before rebooking.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to check the departure time before rebooking because the clock and phone differ.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約に書かれた時刻と、携帯の表示を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me the time on your booking and the display on your phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約は午後三時で、携帯は午後四時を表示しています。でも、上の方に海外の都市名が出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約は十五時で携帯十六時には海外都市名が出ていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: The booking is for three p.m. and the phone shows four p.m. But a foreign city name appears at the top.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the booking says three p.m. and the phone says four with a foreign city name.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 携帯が別の地域の時刻を表示している可能性があります。日本の現在時刻を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: Your phone may be displaying another region's time. Let's check the current time in Japan.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日本の時刻にすると午後二時ですね。予約の出発まで、まだ一時間あるという理解でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 日本時刻十四時なら出発まで一時間あるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: Set to Japan time, it's two p.m. Am I right that there is still one hour until my booked departure?
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese whether Japan time being two means one hour remains before departure.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予約の日付も確認してください。今日の午後三時の便で間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the booking date too. Is it definitely today's three p.m. service?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日付も今日です。時刻だけで乗り遅れたと判断して、同じ便をもう一度買わなくてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約日も今日で時刻誤認による重複購入を避けたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: The date is today too. I'm glad I didn't decide I'd missed it from the time alone and buy the same service again.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the booking date is today and you avoided a duplicate purchase caused by misunderstanding the time.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗り場と案内表示も確認してお待ちください。表示時刻をどれで確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the boarding point and information displays while waiting too. Which display will you use to check the time?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 携帯を日本の時刻へ直し、予約の日付と時刻を案内表示と照らし合わせます。この予約の乗り場で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日本時刻設定と案内を照合し既存予約の乗り場で待つと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll correct my phone to Japan time and compare the booking date and time with the information display. I'll wait at the boarding point for this existing booking.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will set Japan time, compare the information, and wait at the boarding point for the existing reservation.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。出発の案内に気をつけてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please watch for the departure announcement while waiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お食事について何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Can I help you with your meal?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この料理を少し辛くして食べたいです。家族は辛くしないので、鍋全体に入れず私の分だけ調整できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族用の鍋を変えず自分の分だけ辛くしたいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like this dish a little spicy. My family doesn't want it spicy, so can I adjust only my portion without adding anything to the whole pot?
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to make only your portion spicy without changing the family's shared pot.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 追加の調味料について確認します。取り分け用の器はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check about extra seasoning. Do you have a bowl for your portion?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。ただ、すでに料理がいっぱいなので、少量を別の小皿に取って味を試したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 器が満杯なので別の小皿で少量の味見をしたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. But it's already full of food, so I'd like to put a small amount on another small plate and test the taste.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to taste a small portion on another plate because your bowl is full.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 小皿をご用意します。まず少しだけ合わせて、味を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll bring a small plate. First mix just a little and taste it.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。調味料を一度に全部入れず、小皿の一口分から試します。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一口分から少しずつ調味料を試すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I won't add all the seasoning at once; I'll start by trying a bite on the small plate.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will try seasoning little by little, starting with one bite.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 味が合ったら、ご自身の取り分け分を調整してください。共通の鍋へ戻す予定はありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you like the taste, adjust your own portion. You aren't planning to return it to the shared pot, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、試した分は鍋へ戻しません。家族の器にも混ぜないよう、私の小皿を手元へ置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 味見した分を共通鍋や家族の器へ戻さず手元へ置くと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: Correct, I won't return the tasted portion to the pot. I'll keep my small plate near me so it doesn't mix with my family's bowls either.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will keep the tasted food near you without returning it to the shared pot or family bowls.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。調味料を足す時は、容器の注ぎ口を料理につけないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. When adding seasoning, please don't touch the container's spout to the food.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。注ぎ口をつけず少しずつ足して、私の器だけで調整します。鍋の味はそのままにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 注ぎ口を料理につけず私の器だけ調整すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll add it little by little without touching the spout to the food, and adjust only my bowl. I'll leave the pot's flavor unchanged.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the spout off the food and season only your own bowl.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。小皿をお持ちしますので、少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. We'll bring a small plate, so please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お疲れさまです。引継ぎで相談したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Thank you for your work. Is there anything you'd like to discuss for the handover?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 交代の時間ですが、この部材は仮止めまでで本締めが終わっていません。完了と間違われないように伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仮止めのみの部材を完了と誤認させず交代引継ぎしたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's shift-change time, but this component is only temporarily fastened and hasn't been fully tightened. I'd like to make sure it isn't mistaken for finished work.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to hand over a temporarily fastened component without it being mistaken for complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの部材で、どこまで作業したか説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you explain which components and how far you have worked on them?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口側の二本です。位置合わせと仮止めはしましたが、本締めと、その後の確認はまだです。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口側二本は位置合わせ仮止めまでで本締めと確認が未実施と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: The two by the entrance. I've aligned and temporarily fastened them, but haven't fully tightened them or done the checks afterwards.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the entrance-side two are aligned and temporarily fastened but final tightening and inspection are not done.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現場の決められた方法で未完了を示し、責任者にも報告しましょう。次の担当者にはもう伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's indicate the incomplete work using the site's prescribed method and report it to the supervisor too. Have you told the next worker already?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ直接会えていません。道具を片付けただけで終わったように見せず、未完了の内容を先に責任者へ報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 次担当に会えておらず片付けで完了に見せず責任者へ先に報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't met them directly yet. Rather than make it look finished just by putting away the tools, I'll first report the unfinished details to the supervisor.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not met the next worker and will report to the supervisor first without letting tidying imply completion.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。次の担当者が分かったら、口頭の説明だけでなく引継ぎ記録も照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Once you know the next worker, compare the handover record as well as giving a verbal explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 記録には部材の位置と残っている作業を書きます。次の人が読んだと確認できるまでは、伝達済みとはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 位置と残作業を記録し次担当の読了確認まで伝達済みにしないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write the component positions and remaining work in the record. Until I confirm the next person has read it, I won't mark the information as communicated.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will record positions and remaining work, and not mark it communicated until the next worker's reading is confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 引継ぎ後の再開判断と確認は責任者の指示に従ってください。自己判断で作業区域を開放しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Follow the supervisor's instructions for resuming and checking after handover. Don't open the work area on your own judgment.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。仮止め二本と未実施の本締め・確認を報告し、区域の扱いも指示を受けてから引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未完了を報告し区域の扱いも指示を受けて引き継ぐと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll report the two temporarily fastened components and unfinished final tightening and checking, and get instructions about the area before handing over.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will report the incomplete work and receive instructions about the area before handover.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず未完了の場所を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First, let's check the unfinished locations together.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お手続きについて何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having trouble with the procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族へ振り込む入力中に、口座が変わったという電話が来ました。急いで送るよう言われましたが、確定せず相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 口座変更の急な電話を受け振込未確定で相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: While entering a transfer to my family, I received a call saying their account had changed. They told me to send urgently, but I'd like advice without confirming it.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that an unexpected urgent account-change call arrived and you want advice before confirming the transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ振込の確定前ですね。電話は、以前からご存じの番号でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: You haven't confirmed the transfer yet, correct? Was the call from a number you already knew?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、知らない番号でした。家族の名前は言っていましたが、それだけで本人とは確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未知の番号で家族名だけでは本人確認できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, it was an unfamiliar number. They said my family member's name, but that alone doesn't verify who they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that an unknown number and the family name alone do not verify identity.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その電話の内容だけで送金を進めず、ご家族の連絡先を確認してください。普段使っている連絡方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't proceed based only on that call; please confirm your family's contact details. Do you have your usual way to contact them?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 以前から登録している電話番号があります。今かかってきた番号へ折り返さず、そちらから連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 着信番号へ折返さず以前登録した家族番号で確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a phone number saved from before. I'll contact them using that instead of calling back the number that just called.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will use the previously registered family number rather than return the incoming call.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご家族へ何を確かめる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: What are you planning to check with your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 口座を本当に変更したのかと、今日振込を頼んだのかを聞きます。新しい口座番号を読み上げる前に、本人と話しているか確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人確認後に口座変更の事実と本日の振込依頼を尋ねると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: Whether they really changed their account and asked for a transfer today. Before reading out the new account number, I'll verify that I'm speaking to them.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that after identity verification you will ask whether the account change and today's transfer request are genuine.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できない間は、その新しい振込先への操作を進めないでください。入力は担当と一緒に終了できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: While you can't confirm, please don't continue with the new recipient. You can end the entry together with the adviser.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今の操作は確定せず終了したいです。家族へ普段の番号で確認してから、必要なら改めて振込を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 操作を確定せず終え家族への確認後に必要な振込を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd like to end the current operation without confirming it. After checking with my family on their usual number, I'll ask about making a transfer again if needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will end without confirmation and consult about any needed transfer after checking with family.

DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確定していないことを確認し、操作の終了をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-006-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll confirm it hasn't been finalized and explain how to end the operation.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご乗車についてお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with boarding?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 耳が聞こえにくく、今の放送を聞き取れませんでした。乗る列車に変更があったか、文字で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 耳が聞こえにくく直前の放送を聞き取れず乗る列車の変更を文字で確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have difficulty hearing and couldn't catch the announcement just now. I'd like to check in writing whether there has been a change to my train.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to check train changes in writing because hearing difficulties prevented you from understanding the latest announcement.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらの列車をご利用予定ですか。切符か予定の画面を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which train are you planning to take? Could you show your ticket or planned journey screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この十時二十分の列車です。日本語の文字は読めますので、大きな声で繰り返すより、表示や短いメモで教えていただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十時二十分の列車の画面を示し日本語の文字は読めるため表示か短いメモを望む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This ten-twenty train. I can read written Japanese, so a display or short note would help more than repeating it loudly.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the ten-twenty train screen and say in Japanese that you can read Japanese and prefer a display or short note.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の案内を確認しました。メモに「十時三十五分発、二番線」と書きます。予定の十時二十分から十五分遅れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've checked the current guidance. I'll write “departing 10:35, platform 2” on the note. It is fifteen minutes later than the planned 10:20.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十五分遅れで、乗り場は二番線ですね。メモで分かりました。この後また変わるかもしれないので、待つ間も文字で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十五分遅れで二番線とメモを読み返し待機中の変更も文字で確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Fifteen minutes late, platform two, then. The note makes it clear. It might change again, so I'd like to keep checking in writing while waiting.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read back the fifteen-minute delay and platform two in Japanese and say you want written updates while waiting too.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待合室の正面に列車名、時刻、乗り場が出る表示があります。表示を読めない時は、係員へこのメモを見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: A display directly in front of the waiting room shows train names, times and platforms. If you can't read an update, show this note to staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待合場所から見える表示で確認できるか教えてください。画面を見ても分からない変更が出たら、このメモを持って再び相談に来たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待合から見える表示と不明な変更時にメモを持って再相談する方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please show me whether I can check the display from the waiting area. If a change appears that I don't understand, I'd like to bring this note and ask again.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about the display visible from the waiting area and how to return with the note for an unclear change.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが正面の表示です。メモの列車名と同じ行をご覧ください。ご乗車の前にも時刻と乗り場をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the display at the front. Look at the same train-name row as your note. Check the time and platform again before boarding too.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 列車名と時刻、乗り場を文字で確かめます。放送が聞こえたかどうかで決めず、表示が変わって読めない場合は係員へこのメモを見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 列車名時刻乗り場を文字で照合し読めない変更は係員へメモで相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the train name, time and platform in writing. I won't decide based on whether I heard the announcement; if the display changes and I can't read it, I'll show staff this note.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will compare the written train name, time and platform, and use the note with staff for unreadable changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 文字で現在の時刻と乗り場を確認できましたね。このメモをお持ちください。どうぞお気を付けてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've confirmed the current time and platform in writing. Please keep this note. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。問診票でお困りの点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything on the medical questionnaire you're having trouble with?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 痛みを零から十で書く欄があります。十が痛くないという意味だと思って八と書きかけましたが、両端の説明を逆に読んだかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 痛み欄の零と十の意味を逆に読み八と書きかけたため説明を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's a field for pain from zero to ten. I thought ten meant no pain and nearly wrote eight, but may have read the endpoint explanations backwards.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to confirm the pain-scale explanation because you reversed zero and ten and nearly wrote eight.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの用紙では、零の横が「痛みなし」、十の横が「想像できる最も強い痛み」です。どの時点の状態を記入しようとしていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this form, zero says “no pain” and ten says “the strongest pain imaginable.” Which point in time are you trying to describe?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今の状態です。八という数字はその説明を読まずに選んだので、今の痛みが八だと医療スタッフへ伝わらないよう、書き直し方を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 八は尺度を読まず選んだ数字で現在の強さと誤伝達されぬよう訂正方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Right now. I chose eight without reading that explanation, so I'd like to know how to correct it so staff don't understand my current pain to be eight.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to correct eight, chosen without reading the scale, to avoid misrepresenting your current pain.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 訂正の方法をご案内します。数字だけで表しにくいことも、医療スタッフへ言葉で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll explain how to correct it. Please also tell medical staff in words anything that's difficult to express with a number alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は三くらいと感じています。ただ、昨夜はもっと強く、眠れませんでした。同じ数字を一日中の状態として使いたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今は三程度だが昨夜は強く眠れず一日中同じ数字ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Right now it feels about three. But last night it was stronger and I couldn't sleep. I don't want to use one number as if it described the entire day.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that now it is about three, last night it was stronger and prevented sleep, and one number does not describe all day.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 昨夜の状態と今の状態を分けて伝えたいのですね。ほかに伝えたい変化はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You want to distinguish last night's condition from the present one. Are there any other changes you'd like to mention?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今も痛みはあります。昨夜から今までずっと三だったわけではないことと、眠れなかったことを、診察で話せるようメモに残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今も痛く昨夜から三だったわけではないことと睡眠への影響を診察用メモへ残したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It still hurts now. I'd like to note for the examination that it wasn't three all the way from last night until now, and that I couldn't sleep.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that pain remains now, was not three throughout, and you want examination notes about that and sleep disruption.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その内容を医療スタッフへお伝えします。数字だけで受診の必要性をご自身で決めることはせず、状態をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass that on to medical staff. Please discuss your condition rather than deciding for yourself whether care is needed from the number alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 八を書き直す方法を担当に確かめてから訂正します。今は三くらい、昨夜は強くて眠れなかったと分けて伝えます。数字の読み違いも隠さず説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 八の訂正方法を担当に確認してから直し現在三程度と昨夜の強い痛みと眠れなかったことを分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check with the person responsible how to correct eight before changing it. I'll explain separately that it's about three now and was stronger last night so I couldn't sleep. I'll also openly explain misreading the numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will confirm how to correct eight, then describe current pain around three separately from last night's strong pain and inability to sleep.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 八は尺度を読み違えて選んだ数字で、今は三くらい、昨夜は強くて眠れなかったと承りました。訂正方法の確認と症状の説明を医療スタッフへつなぎます。お知らせありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've noted that eight came from misreading the scale, it is about three now, and it was strong enough to prevent sleep last night. I'll connect you to medical staff for correction guidance and symptom explanation. Thank you for telling us.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お買物についてご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Would you like advice about your shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った収納箱について、後日問い合わせる時のためにレシートを残したいです。車に置いたら文字が薄くなっていて、どう記録しておけばよいか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車内保管で薄くなった購入レシートを後日の問合せ用にどう残すか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to keep the receipt for a storage box I bought yesterday in case I need to ask about it later. The printing faded after I left it in the car, so I'd like advice on how to preserve the record.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to keep a purchase receipt faded by storage in a car for a future inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、読める部分と読めない部分を確認しましょう。レシートはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check which parts are readable now and which aren't. Do you have the receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。店名と日付は読めますが、商品の行が一部見えません。読めなかった名前を自分で書き足して、元の印刷のように見せることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店名日付は読め商品行は一部不明で推測した商品名を元印刷として書き足さないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. The store name and date are readable, but part of the item line isn't. I won't write in a guessed name to make it look like the original printing.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the store name and date are readable, part of the item line is unclear, and you will not add a guessed name as original print.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入した商品や包装も、問合せ時の手掛かりになります。ほかに残っている物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The purchased item and packaging can also provide clues for an inquiry. Do you have anything else left?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 箱の包装は残っています。昨日、文字が読めた時に撮った写真もありますが、写真だけで手続きできると決めず、薄くなった実物も保管したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 包装と前日の読める写真があり写真だけの手続き成立を決めず実物も残したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I kept the box packaging. I also have a photo from yesterday when the text was readable, but won't assume a photo alone permits procedures; I'd like to keep the faded original too.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have packaging and yesterday's readable photo, but want to keep the original too without assuming a photo alone is accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どのような問合せをする予定ですか。交換などのお申込みは今ご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: What inquiry are you planning? Do you want to request an exchange now?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は交換の申込みではありません。記録の残し方を聞きたいだけです。今後必要になったら、その時の条件と確認に使える資料を改めて聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日は交換申込でなく記録保存の相談で後日の条件はその時に確かめると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today I'm not applying for an exchange. I only want to ask how to keep records. If needed later, I'll ask again about the conditions and acceptable materials at that time.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that today is about record preservation, not an exchange request, and future conditions will be checked then.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。写真と現物の扱いを担当に確認します。保管のためにレシートへ何か加工をする前にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I'll check with the person responsible how to handle the photo and physical original. Please ask before doing anything to the receipt for storage.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ加工していません。写真、包装、薄くなった実物を分けて残し、読めない所は読めないと説明します。今日は保管方法を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未加工の現物写真包装を分け不明箇所を明示して担当へ保管方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I haven't altered it yet. I'll keep the photo, packaging and faded original separately and explain unreadable parts as unreadable. Today I'll check storage methods with the person responsible.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the unaltered original, photo and packaging separately, identify unknown parts, and ask staff about storage.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。担当に、そのご希望と現在のレシートの状態を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll tell the person responsible your request and the receipt's current condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今買ったおにぎりの包装がうまく取れません。途中の部分から引いてしまったので、開け方の図を一緒に見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入済みおにぎりの包装を途中から引いたため開け方の図を見てほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't remove the wrapper properly from the rice ball I just bought. I pulled from the middle of the process; could you look at the opening diagram with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for help reading the opening diagram because you pulled the purchased rice-ball wrapper out of sequence.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの部分まで開けましたか。食品に触れず、包装の状態を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: How far have you opened it? Please show the wrapper's condition without touching the food.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 中央の帯はまだ残っています。横だけ引いたら、ご飯まで動いたので止めました。不良品だと決めたのではなく、自分の開け方を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 中央帯は残り横を引くとご飯も動いたため止め不良断定でなく自分の操作確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The center strip is still there. When I pulled only the side, the rice moved too, so I stopped. I'm not deciding it's defective; I want to check how I'm opening it.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the center strip remains, pulling the side moved the rice, and you stopped to check your method rather than alleging a defect.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この包装の図では、一番が中央の帯、二番と三番が左右のフィルムです。中央の帯の先端はここにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: On this wrapper's diagram, number one is the center strip, and two and three are the left and right films. The start of the center strip is here.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここに最初の番号がありました。自分が引いた横の所は後の番号です。もう開いた部分を元へ戻そうとはせず、残っている帯をどう扱うか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号順を飛ばしたと理解し開いた部分を戻さず残る帯の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the first number. The side I pulled is a later number. Rather than put the already-opened part back, I'd like to ask how to handle the remaining strip.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you skipped the numbered order and ask how to handle the remaining strip without reversing the opened part.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この図の下向きの矢印に沿って、中央の帯を引く案内です。横のフィルムを一緒に引かず、帯が取れたら次の番号を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The diagram directs you to pull the center strip along this downward arrow. Don't pull the side film together with it; once the strip is off, look at the next number.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。食べる所へ店員さんに直接触れてもらう必要はありません。自分で扱いますので、包装の図で示してもらえると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 食品に店員が直接触れず自分で扱うので包装図で示してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. You don't need to touch the part I'll eat directly. I'll handle it myself, so it would help if you showed me on the wrapper diagram.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will handle the food yourself and want the wrapper diagram used without staff touching the food.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、図のここが中央の帯、こちらが左右のフィルムです。取れた帯を食品から離してから、二番、三番の順に残るフィルムを外してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, this part is the center strip and these are the side films. Keep the removed strip away from the food, then remove the remaining film in the order two, three.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 図の順番と動かす包装を確認して、自分で開けます。取り外したフィルムを食品に戻さず、残った包装の片も確かめてから食べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 図で包装の順序を確認しフィルムを食品へ戻さず残る片も確かめて食べると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the order and which wrapper part to move on the diagram and open it myself. I won't put removed film back on the food, and will check for remaining pieces before eating.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the wrapper order, keep removed film off the food, and check for remaining pieces before eating.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 残っていた帯と左右のフィルムの順番を確認できました。開ける時に包装が残っていないかご覧ください。お声がけありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've confirmed the remaining strip and side-film order. Please check no wrapper is left when opening. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。書類の記入でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having trouble filling in the paperwork?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所を書こうとしたら、町名変更の通知と建物の入口のプレートで町名が違いました。プレートを見て写しかけたので、今使う表記を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 町名変更通知と建物入口の旧住所プレートが違い写しかけた住所の現在表記を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: When writing my address, I found the town-name change notice differs from the plate at the building entrance. I started copying the plate and would like to confirm the current wording.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to confirm the current address after starting to copy an old building plate that differs from the town-name change notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちの通知と、写しかけた住所を見せてください。住まい自体を移られたのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show the notice and the address you started writing. Have you moved home?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 引越しはしていません。同じ建物の二〇一号室です。通知では町名が変わっていますが、入口には以前の町名が残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 引越しせず同じ建物二〇一号室で通知の新町名と残る旧表示の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. It's the same building, apartment 201. The notice changes the town name, but the old town name remains at the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have not moved, remain in apartment 201, and the new notice differs from the old entrance sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通知の対象と変更内容を担当が確認します。番地や建物名については、何が書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person responsible will check what the notice covers and what changed. What does it say about the street number and building name?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 通知にはこの番地が書かれています。町名だけと思い込まず、番地も今の記入内容と比べてほしいです。建物名と部屋番号のメモも持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 町名以外も変化なしと決めず通知の番地と建物名部屋番号メモの照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: This street number is on the notice. Rather than assume only the town name changed, I'd like you to compare the number with my current entry too. I also have a note of the building name and apartment number.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to compare the notice's number and your building-name and apartment note without assuming only the town name changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な住所の範囲を確認しましょう。古いプレートの写真は、通知の代わりではなく違いを説明する資料として扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check all address parts needed. We'll treat the old plate photo as material explaining the difference, not a substitute for the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。写真もありますが、古い表記が残る場所を示すためです。変更の通知を捨てず、書類のどこを直すか案内を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧プレート写真は差異説明用で通知代用ではなく通知を残して訂正案内を受けると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I have a photo too, but it's to show where the old wording remains. I'll keep the change notice and get guidance on which parts of the form to correct.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the old-plate photo explains the difference rather than replacing the notice, and you will keep the notice and follow correction guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの用紙について訂正箇所をご案内します。ほかの登録先への連絡は、それぞれの手続きを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll guide you on corrections to this form. Please check the respective procedures for notifying other registered services.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今の用紙は担当と町名、番地、建物名、部屋番号を照合して直します。ここで確認しただけで銀行なども変更済みとはせず、別に連絡方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用紙の住所各要素を担当と直し銀行等の登録も自動変更済みとはせず別途手続き確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll compare the town name, street number, building name and apartment number with the staff and correct this form. I won't assume checking here automatically changes my bank records and others; I'll check separately how to notify them.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will correct each address element with staff, not assume bank and other registrations changed automatically, and check separate procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通知と旧プレートの違い、番地と建物名、二〇一号室の確認を担当へ引き継ぎます。現在の正式な表記と訂正箇所は、担当の照合後にご確認ください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on the difference between notice and old plate, the street number, building name and apartment 201. Please confirm the current official address and corrections after the adviser compares them. Thank you for your inquiry.
